2.text: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

3.text: And the ships sailing with ease

5.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

6.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

7.text: By the heaven containing pathways,<sup foot_note="227886">1</sup>

footnotes.227886: - Explained as tracks, layers or orbits.

8.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.<sup foot_note="227887">1</sup>

footnotes.227887: - About Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) and the Qur’ān.

9.text: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

11.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

12.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

13.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

14.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

15.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

16.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

17.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,<sup foot_note="227889">1</sup>

footnotes.227889: - i.e., spending a portion of the night in prayer and supplication.

18.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

19.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

20.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

21.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

22.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

23.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

24.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?<sup foot_note="227890">1</sup> -

footnotes.227890: - Who were angels given honored positions by Allāh.

25.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

26.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

27.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

28.text: And he felt from them apprehension.<sup foot_note="227891">1</sup> They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

29.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

30.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

31.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

32.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals<sup foot_note="227892">1</sup>

footnotes.227892: - i.e., those who defied Lot (upon him be peace).

33.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,

34.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

35.text: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

36.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.<sup foot_note="227893">1</sup>

footnotes.227893: - i.e., Lot and his family, excepting his wife.

37.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

38.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.<sup foot_note="227894">1</sup>

39.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

40.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

41.text: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.<sup foot_note="227895">1</sup>

footnotes.227895: - Barren of any benefit, i.e., evil.

42.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

43.text: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

44.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

45.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

46.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

47.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength,<sup foot_note="227896">1</sup> and indeed, We are [its] expander.

48.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

49.text: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

50.text: So flee to Allāh.<sup foot_note="227897">1</sup> Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

footnotes.227897: - i.e., turn to Allāh and take refuge in Him from disbelief and sin, thereby escaping His punishment.

51.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

52.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

53.text: Did they suggest it to them?<sup foot_note="227898">1</sup> Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

footnotes.227898: - i.e., Did the former disbelievers pass on these words to the Makkans so that they repeat the same expressions?

54.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

55.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

56.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

57.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

58.text: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,<sup foot_note="227899">1</sup> the firm possessor of strength.

footnotes.227899: - Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence.  His provision includes guidance.

59.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

60.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
